decision.required_claim_wording: Unconstrained-primary-input sequential observational equivalence passes for all 1,268 port and 4,100 observable-DFF compare points. The 320 counter DFFs are unobservable in this selected-slice top; they are matched but not compared in RTL-to-RTL and are removed from the mapped netlist. Do not call M420 all-internal-state equivalence.

unread_dff_semantic_audit.rtl_to_rtl_relationship: All 320 pairs are name-matched between serial and balanced RTL but Formality marks them Unread and does not compare them.
unread_dff_semantic_audit.rtl_to_netlist_relationship: All 320 are unmatched reference unread DFFs and have no implementation counterpart.
unread_dff_semantic_audit.topology: The submodules export the counters only through debug outputs. The selected-slice shell connects them to local matcher_debug_* and adapter_debug_* wires that have no downstream reader and do not drive any top output, control decision, protocol check or data path.
unread_dff_semantic_audit.optimization_legality: The mapped-netlist removal is consistent with the proven observational cone. It does not establish equality of the removed internal counter values.

m416_warning_reconciliation.closure: The balanced-RTL-to-mapped-netlist proof closes the effect of the elaborated conversion semantics on all observable compare points. The warnings remain source diagnostics and must not be described as three optimized registers.

findings.title: M420 overstates all-state equivalence and hides unread points behind the default unmatched report
findings.detail: The serial-to-balanced status contains 320 DFF pairs under Not Compared/Unread. The balanced-to-netlist match summary contains 320 reference and zero implementation unmatched unread DFFs. M420's default report_unmatched_points omits unread points, so its receipt fields all_state_equivalence=true and unmatched_points=0 are too broad even though verify succeeds with 5,368 passing observable compare points.
findings.repair_gate: Cite M421's all-input-trace observational-equivalence wording. Do not claim all internal state or every legal/unreachable state unless the 320 counters are explicitly exposed/targeted and independently proved. Qualify unmatched=0 as zero unmatched compare and primary/black-box points, plus 320 reference unread debug-counter DFFs in RTL-to-netlist.

findings.title: The M420 contract misclassifies three VER-318 warnings as optimized registers
findings.detail: M416 has three VER-318 signed/unsigned elaboration conversion warnings, not three optimized registers. The actual optimized-away state consists of 320 debug-counter DFF bits reported with OPT-1207. Formality closes observable behavior affected by the conversions and legitimately tolerates removal of the dead counters, but the two categories must not be conflated.
findings.repair_gate: Use the exact warning taxonomy in every receipt or paper audit: VER-318=conversion semantics; OPT-1207=320 unobservable debug-counter removals.

findings.title: The mapped-netlist proof retains power-cell linkage diagnostics
findings.detail: Both M420 and the independent M421 netlist proof report 375 unlinked power cells twice. No compare point fails and no black box is introduced, so the functional result stands; this is not a UPF or power-intent proof.
findings.repair_gate: Retain the warning in provenance and rerun under the eventual power-intent/library setup before any power-domain claim.

findings.title: Formality admission is functional only
findings.detail: M420/M421 establish selected-slice observable equivalence. They do not establish PrimeTime timing, routed timing, SRAM integration, SAIF/PTPX power, energy, new cycle speedup, system speedup or paper-ready PPA.
findings.repair_gate: Proceed to PrimeTime STA as a diagnostic. Keep power and PPA claims closed until the corresponding measured gates pass.
